title: Hell's Heart
description: Gideon the Ninth meets Moby-Dick in USA Today bestselling author Alexis Hall’s thrilling SF debut, Hell’s Heart![Charli Anne] Delores' irreverent, fourth wall-breaking narration is the highlight here, making listeners feel like they’re listening to a friend’s raucous story. - Booklist[Charli Ann] Delores brings an entire interstellar melting pot to life, sharply voicing characters who represent a range of genders,...
